programs.title: The 90-Day Stability & Posture Program
programs.subtitle: Stand taller, balance better, move with control.

weeks.themeSubtitle: See where your posture starts, and wake up the small muscles that hold you steady.

days.title: Unslouch Session
days.intention: We stack your alignment today so good posture starts to feel like home. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Footing First
days.intention: We narrow your base today and let your ankles, hips, and core figure it out. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: Pillar Work
days.intention: A strong core holds your posture up all day. Today we build that anchor. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Standing Strong Flow
days.intention: Today's warriors and triangles train your body to be both grounded and tall. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Moving Well
days.intention: We practice everyday movements today so moving well becomes automatic. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. You are exactly where you need to be in this process.

days.title: The Steady Test
days.intention: We narrow your base today and let your ankles, hips, and core figure it out. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Give yourself full credit for pressing play today.

days.title: The Exhale Day
days.intention: Today is deliberately lighter: long stretches, soft breath, and space to notice your progress. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.
